description: How the bot should react to the mobs it meets on its first nights, for threatOf and nightThreats. Hand-written; each entry names its evidence. confidence: 'documented' = docs/research/rotn-progression.md section 2 (hazard table), which cites the RotN wiki ([W-...]); 'vanilla' = Minecraft 1.12 behaviour that the RotN sources do not mention, unverified on this pack; 'verified' = read from the mod's bytecode in the pinned pack (javap -c -p (reads class files; runs no mod code) on the jar from the pinned server pack zip (SHA-256 90642fd5...f5205); SRG names checked against MCP stable-39-1.12 fields.csv), each entry citing the jar, class and methods; 'inferred' = not checked against the mod's code (each such entry says so in its evidence). Order (first match wins): a dangerous mob (entity-overrides.json) is always 'avoid' (source 'override'); then an entry in 'entities'; then the first 'classRules' entry whose pattern matches the dumped class's simple name (source 'inferred'); then a default from the threat level (entity(): hostile = IMob or bytecode-cited player targeting): hostile -> fight, otherwise ignore (source 'default'). Class rules apply to hostile mobs only. Optional fields on an entry or class rule: 'ranged', 'explodes', and 'lookAt': false for a mob that is dangerous to look at: its targeting starts when a player looks at it (the enderman's stare check), or its gaze attack needs the player to look back (the gorgon), so the bot must not look at its head; threatOf returns lookAt true otherwise. Reactions: 'fight' (fight, ideally at a choke point; retreat when outnumbered), 'keep-distance' (back off at once, do not melee), 'take-cover' (ranged attacker: stay behind cover), 'avoid' (do not engage; move away), 'ignore-unless-provoked' (neutral until attacked or provoked), 'ignore'.

general.summary: At night stay sealed in a cobblestone or stone shelter with light only inside; a dirt shack is not safe because mobs dig and pillar. Retreat if two or more hostiles come at once.

mod_lavacow:parasite.summary: A small 7-health crawler that can burst from a dead zombie, frozen zombie or mushroom zombie, or from sand dug in a dry (desert) biome. If it touches you it latches on, infests you (a slow hunger drain) and keeps biting for 1 damage, renewing the infestation with each bite, so waiting does not shake it off; unattached, it dies by itself after about 16 s. Kill it in one or two hits before it reaches you, or back away from the corpse until it dies; if one is on you, kill it.
evidence: Fish's Undead Rising-1.3.2.jar (in the pack as mods/Fish's Undead Rising-1.3.2.jar, SHA-256 f45662c8b3ba6a46d251fbb56044bdc5290d1102d23500ad0dfd927aa9bf5c50): EntityParasite extends EntitySpider; applyEntityAI (func_175456_n) bytecode 5-16 adds EntityAINearestAttackableTarget(EntityPlayer, checkSight true) at priority 2, and bytecode 24-42 a second one for EntityLivingBase with a predicate (Modconfig.Parasite_Plague; config/Fishs_Undead_Rising.cfg line 619 'parasite attacks everything'=false)

Stats: applyEntityAttributes (func_110147_ax): MAX_HEALTH = Modconfig.Parasite_Health (config/Fishs_Undead_Rising.cfg line 625 'parasite health'=7.0), FOLLOW_RANGE 8.0 at bytecode 26, MOVEMENT_SPEED 0.2 at 41, ATTACK_DAMAGE = Modconfig.Parasite_Attack (cfg line 613 'parasite attack'=1.0)

Attaching: collideWithEntity (func_82167_n) bytecode 11-135: when a living entity that is a non-creative player (EntityPlayer.isCreative func_184812_l_ false), or a listed host, touches it and Modconfig.Parasite_Attach is set (cfg line 616 'parasite attacks by attaching onto target'=true), it gives that entity INFESTED for 160 ticks (sipush 160 at 79), rides it (startRiding func_184220_m at 91), sets long_live = true (126; the lifespan stops counting) and makes it its attack target (setAttackTarget func_70624_b at 135)
On hit: attackEntityAsMob (func_70652_k) bytecode 9-59: on a player (with Parasite_Attach) it re-applies INFESTED for 160 ticks; with skin 2 also Poison (field_76436_u) for 80 ticks (bytecode 63-87)
MobEffectInfested (performEffect func_76394_a): on a player it calls addExhaustion (func_71020_j) with 0.005f times (amplifier + 1) (bytecode 1-18): a slow hunger drain, no damage

Lifespan and release: lifespawn starts at 320 ticks (constructors, sipush 320 at 19). onLivingUpdate (func_70636_d) bytecode 1-257: it counts down unless long_live; at 0 it kills itself (attackEntityFrom with causeMobDamage(self).setDamageIsAbsolute, its max health), or, for skin 2 with a player in follow range and nextInt(100) < Modconfig.pSpawnRate_Vespa, it turns into a Vespa cocoon; the pack sets 'vespa spawn rate'=0 (cfg line 805), so on this pack it only dies. Bytecode 262-353: while riding a living entity it dismounts (dismountEntity func_110145_l, dismountRidingEntity func_184210_p) and kills itself once the host has no INFESTED, and if the host is burning (isBurning func_70027_ad) it catches fire (setFire func_70015_d 20) and drops off

Where it comes from: Fish's Undead Rising-1.3.2.jar ModEventHandler.onEDeath (LivingDeathEvent) bytecode 158-304: in a surface world (WorldProvider.isSurfaceWorld func_76569_d), a dying mob spawns parasites if it is in the host list and either nextInt(100) < Modconfig.pSpawnRate_Parasite or a parasite rides it (bytecode 167-207), or, for any mob, if it has INFESTED (211-220; so a player who dies infested leaves parasites at the corpse); the count is (3 + nextInt(3)) + (amplifier - 1) * (1 + nextInt(3)), where amplifier is INFESTED's amplifier or 0, so 0 to 4 for a mob without the effect or with Infested I. Pack config: host list lines 606-610 (minecraft:zombie, mod_lavacow:zombiefrozen, mod_lavacow:zombiemushroom; the default's husk, unburied and mummy are removed), 'parasite spawn rate'=5 (line 628). Not in any spawn list of the dump's spawns.json

Sand: ModEventHandler.onBlockDestroyed (BlockEvent.HarvestDropsEvent) bytecode 217-340: when a block of Material.SAND (field_151595_p) is broken in a biome with BiomeDictionary type DRY in the overworld, and nextInt(100) < Modconfig.Parasite_SandSpawn (cfg line 622 'parasite from sand blocks'=1) and pSpawnRate_Parasite > 0, a parasite spawns there
processInteract (func_184645_a) bytecode 2-69: a player with an empty hand can pick it up as an item (FishItems.PARASITE_ITEM) and it vanishes (setDead func_70106_y)
docs/research/rotn-progression.md section 2, Zombies: 'Parasites may drop when they die ... After killing one that carries a Parasite, move away from it' ([W-Zombie])

Not settled: whether a player can reach the empty-hand pickup on a parasite that is riding them; whether Rough Mobs or Special AI change it (config/ZombieAwareness/MobLists.cfg line 274 enables Zombie Awareness for it; roughmobsrevamped.cfg lines 2195 and 2506-2509 name it only in pairings, not read further); the server's difficulty; which blocks count as Material.SAND on this pack (in vanilla 1.12 sand and gravel); whether the sand spawn needs a player harvester
